```artifact
Feature: User Experience and System Navigation

  Scenario: User navigates through the system easily
    Given the user is on the Get Started page
    When the user clicks on the Help button
    Then the user should be redirected to the tutorial page

  Scenario: User completes a consultation request
    Given the user is on the consultation request page
    When the user fills in the required fields and clicks on the Next button
    Then the user should be taken to the next step in the consultation process

  Scenario: User completes a consultation request within 5 minutes
    Given the user is on the consultation request page
    When the user fills in the required fields and clicks on the Next button
    Then the user should be taken to the next step in the consultation process within 5 minutes

  Scenario Outline: User completes a consultation request with edge values
    Given the user is on the consultation request page
    When the user fills in the required fields with <value> and clicks on the Next button
    Then the user should be taken to the next step in the consultation process
    Examples:
      | value |
      | as specified |
      | minimum value |
      | maximum value |

  Scenario Outline: User completes a consultation request with invalid values
    Given the user is on the consultation request page
    When the user fills in the required fields with <value> and clicks on the Next button
    Then the user should see an error message
    Examples:
      | value |
      | empty field |
      | invalid format |
      | too long |
      | too short |

  Scenario: System navigation is simple and intuitive
    Given the user is on the Get Started page
    When the user clicks on the Help button
    Then the user should be redirected to the tutorial page
    And the tutorial page should have clear instructions
    And the tutorial page should have examples
```
